## Description of the improvement

Explain clearly what you would like to see added or changed.

## Motivation

Why is this improvement important? What problem does it solve or what workflow does it enable?

## Example of use

How do you expect to use this feature? If it involves a CLI command, show an example:

```bash
rawfeed <command>
```

## Alternatives considered

Describe other approaches or workarounds you have evaluated and why they are not sufficient.

## Additional context

Include any references, links, or context that may help evaluate this request.
